skills.name: Ink Splash (墨染/墨染)
skills.line: Do you want me to put you into my book as well?
skills.description: Shoyou attacks a single target with his brush, dealing damage equal to 100% of his ATK.

skills.name: Roam (云游/雲游)
skills.line: Roam the world until you truly find yourself.
skills.description: Shoyou restores the HP of an ally by 8% of his max HP and dispels or removes a control effect on them. Also grants them Heavenly Scroll: Seamless, sustained for 1 turn. ; : ;Heavenly Scroll： Seamless :'''Buff, Status''': When receiving non-transferred damage, limits the damage to 15% of their max HP.

upgrades.text: '''Heavenly Scroll: Seamless''': Damage limit decreases to 12%.
Also use Scroll of Everything (at skill level 1) without spending any onibi on the enemy with the lowest HP proportion.
'''Heavenly Scroll: Seamless''': Damage limit decreases to 9%.
Also restores the HP of the ally with the lowest HP proportion by 8% of his max HP and grants them Heavenly Scroll: Seamless.

skills.name: Scroll of Everything (万象之书/万象の書)
skills.line: My pen creates and destroys, from the highest mountain to the smallest ant!
skills.description: Shoyou inflicts Heavenly Scroll: Heart Assault on 1 enemy, sustained for 1 turn, and deals damage equal to 80% of his ATK. ;Heavenly Scroll： Heart Assault : :'''Debuff, Status''': Records damage dealt. Inflicts indirect damage equal to 50% of the recorded damage (cannot exceed 1200% of his max HP) when the effect is released.

upgrades.text: '''Heavenly Scroll: Heart Assault''': Indirect damage increases to 75%.
Also use Roam (at skill level 1) without spending any onibi on the ally with the lowest HP proportion.
'''Heavenly Scroll: Heart Assault''': Indirect damage increases to 100%.
Also inflicts damage equal to 80% of his ATK on the enemy with the lowest HP proportion and inflicts Heavenly Scroll: Heart Assault on them.

bio.condition: With Shoyou clear stage 10 of the Orochi soul zone (solo).
Gain 200000 EXP by placing Shoyou in Realm Training.
With Shoyou win 30 times in Duel, Practice or Spar.
